title: Mishlove's eleven-year study of Ted Owens

tellings.quote: I worked with Owens for 11 years from 1976 to 1987 when he died. [laughter]

plain: The researcher Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a doctorate and studies psychic claims, says he worked with a man named Ted Owens for eleven years, from 1976 until Owens died in 1987. He tells Michels this from his own experience and draws on his own files on Owens, and he places the work beside that of Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ, physicists who tested psychics for the US government. If his account holds, it was a long, close study of one man said to have unusual powers.
